baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence حَسِبَ, يَسْبِقُونَا, and يَحْكُمُونَ joins estimation, getting beyond a pursuer, and judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mental estimate becomes a race forecast and then a self-issued verdict: intentional offenders calculate that they can move beyond divine reach, while the closing blame reverses their judgment.

activation_trace.role: Contributes uncertain estimation and functions as the offenders' forecast.
Contributes evasion from a pursuer and supplies the forecast's claimed outcome.
Contributes adjudication and turns the estimate into a self-authorizing verdict.

changed_reading.before: People who do evil think they will escape punishment.
changed_reading.after: The offenders perform a self-serving forecast and formally treat imagined evasion as their verdict; the verse judges the judging process itself as bad.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَسِبَ can evoke accounting beside intentional يَعْمَلُونَ, doubled س و ء, and the adjudicative close.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate bad output is mentally entered into a false account whose proposed settlement is escape; the second use of the badness root evaluates both the output and the settlement.

activation_trace.role: Contributes counting and accounting and frames the thought as a miscomputed account.
Contributes purposive action and supplies what enters the account.
Contributes ugliness to both the produced acts and the verdict evaluating their outcome.
Contributes adjudication and functions as the false closing of the account.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely labels acts and an opinion as evil.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts purposive bad production followed by a miscomputed settlement, so corrupt evaluation is continuous with corrupt work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated estimate in 29:2 asks about being released without assay; 29:3 makes assay disclose stable differences. The focus race therefore includes an attempt to get ahead of examination and disclosure, not only of later penalty.

activation_trace.role: Contributes evasion from a pursuer and remains the focus anchor for preemptive escape.
Repeats estimation and places the focus calculation inside the opening test question.
Contributes release from a thing and defines the exemption being imagined.
Contributes assay of metal or person and functions as the blocked examination.
Contributes disclosure to a knower and makes tested difference manifest.

structural_cues: 29:2 repeats the focus question-form before release, profession, and testing; 29:3 orders prior testing before the disclosure of truthful and lying groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, assay, and disclosure; I infer that assay blocks unexamined release and that outstripping would preempt disclosure. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns only delayed punishment.

changed_reading.before: The offenders calculate that they can outrun a later consequence.
changed_reading.after: They calculate that they can pass through the moral field unassayed and get ahead of the disclosure that would expose what their profession or conduct is worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, work is repaid, proposed transfer of faults fails, liabilities become carried weights, performed work is tasted, and workers receive wages. The focus's false account is corrected by a conservation pattern: purposive output remains attached until settlement.

activation_trace.role: Contributes accounting and anchors the focus as a false computation.
Contributes purposive work and supplies the positively repaid counterpart to the focus output.
Contributes matching an act with its recompense and supplies settlement of work.
Contributes bearing liability and exposes the proposed transfer of faults as a liability claim.
Contributes measurable weight and materializes liabilities that cannot simply disappear.
Contributes experiential testing and turns performed work into an encountered result.
Contributes compensation for work and closes the surah's labor-accounting pattern.

structural_cues: 29:7 pairs repeated work with recompense; 29:12-13 first denies transferred fault-bearing and then assigns real burdens; 29:55 makes work tasted; 29:58 names the workers' wage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account, recompense, liability, weight, tasting, and wage; I infer a conservation rule tying work to its worker through settlement. The alternative is a set of independent metaphors rather than one accounting mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The offenders miscalculate that bad work can end without adverse settlement.
changed_reading.after: Their judgment attempts to write purposive evil off the account, but the surah renders work nontransferable and encounterable as liability, weight, tasted result, or wage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus race is replayed first as unprecedented transgression and later as the failure of elevated historical powers to get away before each is seized by its fault. Being ahead in wrongdoing supplies no precedence over accountability.

activation_trace.role: Contributes advance and competition and anchors the focus race.
Contributes prior advance and recasts precedence as being first in a transgression.
Contributes crossing a limit and specifies the domain in which precedence is claimed.
Contributes failure to evade a pursuer and answers the focus claim in a historical sequence.
Contributes self-exalting greatness and supplies the posture behind claimed precedence.
Contributes being taken to account for fault and supplies the race's reversal.
Contributes culpable fault and ties capture to each actor's own conduct.

structural_cues: 29:28 uses the focus root for unmatched prior transgression; 29:39 denies precedence to exalted powers; 29:40 immediately distributes distinct forms of capture by fault.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed uses of precedence followed by capture; I infer that novelty or firstness in wrongdoing can be treated as a status claim that falsely promises exemption. Alternatively, 29:28 may mark historical uniqueness without any sought status.

changed_reading.before: Outstripping means only running faster than a pursuer.
changed_reading.after: Outstripping also names the fantasy that being historically first, exceptional, or elevated in wrongdoing places one ahead of the ordinary account; the historical sequence reverses that prestige into capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed appointment moves toward meeting, while the same opponents try to pull consequence forward; sudden arrival and universal return defeat both directions of temporal control. The focus race is about owning the schedule, whether by fleeing or hurrying.

activation_trace.role: Contributes racing advance and anchors the attempted control of timing.
Contributes the convergence of facing things and gives the timeline a meeting point.
Contributes a fixed temporal limit and establishes the schedule's endpoint.
Contributes speeding and bringing forward and reverses flight into a demand for acceleration.
Contributes sudden surprise and denies the challengers control of arrival.
Contributes being returned and closes every personal timeline at the same destination.

structural_cues: 29:5 says the appointed term is coming; 29:53 repeats the demand to hasten consequence but assigns it a named term and surprise; 29:57 makes return universal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies race, appointment, hastening, surprise, and return; I infer that fleeing and taunting acceleration are opposite attempts to control one schedule. The alternative is that hastening is rhetorical disbelief unrelated to the focus's race image.

changed_reading.before: They hope to move ahead of consequence in one direction.
changed_reading.after: They try to own divine timing, either outrunning its arrival or daring it to arrive early, but meeting, fixed term, surprise, and return leave the schedule outside their judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The race field is explicitly closed: no one can make pursuit fail across earth or sky, consequence already encircles, and its encounter comes from above and below. Speed cannot solve a topological enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Contributes escape from a pursuer and anchors the spatial claim.
Contributes outdistancing and escape from pursuit and explicitly negates the focus possibility.
Contributes overpowering enclosure and turns a future chase into an already closed field.
Contributes the upper direction and supplies one boundary of the enclosure.
Contributes the lower direction and closes the opposite boundary.

structural_cues: 29:22 spans earth and sky while denying escape; 29:54 says consequence is already encompassing; 29:55 specifies above and below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit escape-from-pursuit, enclosure, and opposed vertical limits; I infer one spatial model that makes speed irrelevant. Alternatively, the statements may be separate assertions of power and punishment.

changed_reading.before: Outstripping is a contest in which greater speed might in principle matter.
changed_reading.after: There is no open course to win: the pursuer cannot be disabled, the field is already enclosed, and its vertical bounds deny an exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 29:38, deeds are made attractive, agents are diverted from the traversable path, yet retain a claim to insight. The focus's bad judgment is therefore a perceptual production loop: beautified output generates confidence that protects the output from correction.

activation_trace.role: Contributes judgment that should hit truth by knowledge and anchors the corrupted evaluative faculty.
Contributes displaying something as beautiful and supplies the cosmetic recoding of deeds.
Contributes purposive deeds and identifies what is cosmetically recoded.
Contributes diversion and functions as the behavioral effect of recoded perception.
Contributes a traversable extended path and supplies what diversion prevents them from following.
Contributes inward insight and marks the agents' confidence that they see clearly.

structural_cues: Within one ayah, 29:38 orders beautification of their works, diversion from the path, and continued self-description as perceptive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attractive presentation, deeds, diversion, path, and claimed insight; I infer that beautification causes a confident false verdict that sustains conduct. The alternative is a noncausal list of deceptions and responses.

changed_reading.before: They perform bad acts and afterward happen to judge escape possible.
changed_reading.after: Their bad judgment is part of the machinery of bad work: adorned deeds look right, apparent insight ratifies them, and that verdict keeps correction off their path.

context_deltas.mechanism: At sea, threatened actors turn sincerely toward God; after God separates them from danger onto land, they resume association. A protected sanctuary amid surrounding snatching repeats the error. Experienced rescue is reclassified as autonomous safety, making rescue by God feel like escape from God.

activation_trace.role: Contributes estimation and anchors the mistaken classification of safety.
Contributes escape from a pursuer and anchors the difference between rescue and imagined evasion.
Contributes deliverance by separation and supplies actual rescue from maritime danger.
Contributes dry land and supplies the safe surface on which rescue is misread.
Contributes association with God and marks the behavioral reversal after deliverance.
Contributes protected sacred space and supplies a second experienced zone of safety.
Contributes secure calm and links protected safety to the ayah's contrasting act of belief.
Contributes swift snatching and makes the sanctuary's surrounding danger visible.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from peril and exclusive invocation through divine rescue to land and renewed association; 29:67 places secure sanctuary inside a region of snatching and immediately contrasts false belief with ingratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies peril, rescue, landfall, renewed association, protected space, and external snatching; I infer that safety is misclassified as independence from its giver. The live alternative is a temporal relapse with no causal role for experienced safety.

changed_reading.before: Outstripping means obtaining safety before divine pursuit catches up.
changed_reading.after: One form of the focus error is to receive safety from God and then count that rescue as evidence of independence from God, confusing deliverance from danger with deliverance from accountability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus verb normally presents reckoning, not a direct claim of sufficiency; it remains anchored in the supplied ح س ب sufficiency branch and is sharply activated by the packet's ك ف ي branch that explicitly calls a thing حسب and sufficient. Render it as lexical resonance, not replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَسِبَ carries a supplied sufficiency branch alongside the overt estimate that the offenders can outstrip.

activation_trace.role: Contributes sufficiency and lets the offenders' estimate resonate as self-sufficiency.
Contributes protective alliance and supplies the support treated as sufficient.
Contributes weakness of force and exposes the insufficiency of that support.
Contributes declaring a thing حسب and sufficient and directly activates the distant focus branch.
Contributes present witnessing and specifies what divine sufficiency accomplishes.

changed_reading.before: They merely think escape is possible.
changed_reading.after: Their thought also faintly resonates as a sufficiency claim: they count themselves or their supports enough to get beyond God, while the surah counters that God is sufficient as present witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridle and race-follower senses are peripheral cross-domain branches, so they should never be offered as the direct meaning of the clauses. They remain worth carrying because the focus itself joins a race root to a judgment root whose inventory includes a bridle, while 29:45 joins a race-follower branch to explicit restraint of ugliness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَسْبِقُونَا supplies the race, while يَحْكُمُونَ supplies a bridle that restrains a running animal.

activation_trace.role: Contributes racing advance and supplies the attempted leading position.
Contributes the bridle that checks a running animal and recasts judgment as moral steering.
Contributes the runner who follows the leader and supplies a counter-posture to trying to precede.
Contributes checking and restraining action and gives the counter-race its ethical brake.
Contributes overt ugliness and identifies what proper restraint checks.
Contributes reprehensible conduct that is to be checked and completes the restraint contrast.

changed_reading.before: Their judgment is only an incorrect proposition about winning a race.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they also steer the race badly: instead of disciplined following that restrains ugly conduct, their moral bridle is reversed and licenses the attempt to take the leading position beyond God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The forensic link from a surviving ruin to every evader is reader-supplied and should be qualified as a material analogy, not a universal lexical rule. It remains anchored in the focus's evasion and adjudication and in 29:35's explicit branch sequence of leaving, visible sign, and disclosure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَسْبِقُونَا frames attempted evasion and يَحْكُمُونَ frames adjudication, allowing a remaining trace to function as evidence against escape.

activation_trace.role: Contributes evasion from a pursuer and supplies the attempted departure from the scene.
Contributes adjudication and supplies the forensic use of what remains.
Contributes an effect remaining after departure and turns absence into residue.
Contributes a visible sign and makes the residue evidentiary.
Contributes appearance and disclosure and makes the sign legible.

changed_reading.before: Escape would mean leaving both the pursuer and the deed behind.
changed_reading.after: The surah permits a forensic counterimage: departure can leave a disclosed sign, so the very residue of an attempted escape can remain available to judgment.

strongest_changes: The opening assay sequence turns escape into attempted preemption of examination and disclosure.
The work-recompense-burden-taste-wage chain makes outcomes nontransferable and materially attached to purposive output.
Fixed appointment and spatial enclosure turn the race into a failed effort to control either schedule or field.
The rescue scenes expose the category error of treating rescue by God as escape from God.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reuses the focus's estimation, work, race, and judgment mechanisms across assay, accounting, perception, enclosure, and rescue, so several changed readings remain live without being merged.
remaining_uncertainties: 29:28 may mark historical uniqueness without implying that firstness was sought as status or exemption.
The rescue-to-land sequence may be a temporal contrast rather than a causal misclassification of safety.
The sufficiency, bridle, race-follower, and evidentiary-residue readings are branch-level resonances rather than direct lexical replacements.
